"import json
import numpy as np
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc

# ====================================================================
# Design point: SL, Fn_target=12000 lbf, T4=2450 degR, OPR=14.0
# Simple turbojet: Inlet + AXI5 Compressor + Combustor + LPT2269 Turbine + CD Nozzle + Shaft
# Thermo: AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC (tabular)
# ====================================================================

FN_DES = 12000.0   # lbf, target net thrust
T4_DES = 2450.0    # degR, combustor exit (turbine inlet) temperature
OPR_DES = 14.0     # compressor pressure ratio
MN = 0.0           # Mach number (static, sea-level)
ALT = 0.0          # ft, sea level

# Tabular thermo package
thermo = pyc.thermo.tabular.TabularThermo('AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the cycle as a Group so we can wrap it with a BalanceComp
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
prob = om.Problem()
cycle = prob.model.add_subsystem('cycle', om.Group())

# Components
cycle.add_subsystem('fc',    pyc.FlightCondition(thermo_data=thermo))
cycle.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet(thermo_data=thermo))
cycle.add_subsystem('comp',  pyc.Compressor(map_data=pyc.AXI5,    design=True,
                                            thermo_data=thermo))
cycle.add_subsystem('comb',  pyc.Combustor(thermo_data=thermo))
cycle.add_subsystem('turb',  pyc.Turbine(map_data=pyc.LPT2269, design=True,
                                         thermo_data=thermo))
cycle.add_subsystem('nozz',  pyc.Nozzle(thermo_data=thermo))
cycle.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft())

# Flow-station connections
cycle.connect('fc.Fl_O',    'inlet.Fl_I')
cycle.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
cycle.connect('comp.Fl_O',  'comb.Fl_I')
cycle.connect('comb.Fl_O',  'turb.Fl_I')
cycle.connect('turb.Fl_O',  'nozz.Fl_I')

# Mechanical (shaft torque balance)
cycle.connect('comp.trq', 'shaft.trq_in')
cycle.connect('turb.trq', 'shaft.trq_out')

# Shaft-computed Nmech drives the rotating machinery
cycle.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'comp.Nmech')
cycle.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'inlet.Nmech')
cycle.connect('shaft.Nmech', 'turb.Nmech')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Implicit balance: pick the inlet mass-flow W so that Fn = 12000 lbf
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
bal = om.BalanceComp()
bal.add_balance('W', val=100.0, units='lbm/s', lower=10.0, upper=600.0)
prob.model.add_subsystem('FN_bal', bal)

prob.model.connect('cycle.nozz.Fn', 'FN_bal.lhs', src_indices=[0])
prob.model.connect('FN_bal.W',      'cycle.fc.W')

# Constant target for the balance (rhs)
prob.model.add_subsystem('FN_target',
                         om.IndepVarComp('FN', val=FN_DES, units='lbf'))
prob.model.connect('FN_target.FN', 'FN_bal.rhs')

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Input defaults (flight condition, component knobs)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
prob.model.set_input_defaults('cycle.fc.MN',              MN)
prob.model.set_input_defaults('cycle.fc.alt',            ALT)
prob.model.set_input_defaults('cycle.fc.W',              100.0)
prob.model.set_input_defaults('cycle.inlet.ram_recovery', 1.0)
prob.model.set_input_defaults('cycle.shaft.Nmech',       8000.0, units='rpm')
prob.model.set_input_defaults('cycle.comb.dPqP',         0.05)
prob.model.set_input_defaults('cycle.comb.turbFuelInj_eta', 1.0)
prob.model.set_input_defaults('cycle.comb.temperature',  T4_DES)
prob.model.set_input_defaults('cycle.nozz.Cv',           0.99)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Solver
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
prob.model.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver()
prob.model.nonlinear_solver.options['maxiter'] = 100
prob.model.nonlinear_solver.options['iprint']   = 2
prob.model.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver()

prob.setup()

# Burn-in iteration: simple successive subs"
